parameters.name: NetworkCardIndex
parameters.description:
The index of the network card specified for the ENI.

>The valid values of NetworkCardIndex depend on the instance family. If the instance type does not support NetworkCard, you cannot specify this parameter. If the instance type supports NetworkCard, see [Instance families](~~25378~~) for valid values.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: TrunkNetworkInstanceId
parameters.description:
The trunk ENI ID.
>This parameter is not yet available.
